text.p: ING Barings said it cut its rating on glass-maker Cristalerias de Chile to sell from hold, citing falls in glass sales volumes and losses in the company's media division.

"We feel Cristales deserves to be trading at a discount to the market due to modest growth prospects for its glass packaging business and uncertainty over the profitability of its media division," ING said in a report.

ING said it has lowered its 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates on Cristalerias by 10 percent as a result of the lower-than-expected growth in the company's glass packaging business and higher-than-forecast losses in its television operations.
Cristales's stock was unchanged mid-morning at 3,000 pesos.
